title: The Shadow Approaching Haibara's Secret
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan/Kudo, Ai Haibara, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Dr. Agasa, Masumi Sera, Inspector Yamamura, Officer Kojima) omitted by convention -- they are present throughout but not case-specific to this murder plot. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Old cases/ file (single 'Campground in Gunma forest' location, single 'knows' edge per suspect, generic events) got the culprit, victim, and dying-message clue correct, but under-specified: it collapsed the burial site and the mountain cabin (two distinct crime scenes) into one location node, omitted the corroborating physical evidence (axe wound angle + footprint stance proving the killer is right-handed; luminol-positive bloodstains on Usagi's washed clothes), omitted the two innocent suspects' stated alibi activities, and did not mention the unidentified woman who rescued the trapped children from the burning cabin (implied elsewhere in the franchise to be tied to the 'Black Organization'/Bourbon subplot referenced in this two-parter's title and cold open/epilogue -- that subplot involves only already-omitted recurring cast plus an unnamed hacker, so it is not modeled here beyond this note). case_type: murder. The cabin-arson/kidnapping-of-the-Detective-Boys thread is modeled only via Usagi's edges toward the cabin location itself (chains_shut/sets_fire_to), since the people endangered by it are the omitted recurring cast.

attrs.claustrophobia: trapped inside an elevator for a full day in an accident three years earlier; panics whenever shut in a dark, enclosed space since
attrs.cover_story: traveling around Japan photographing campsite scenery

attrs.plan: tried to cure Usagi's claustrophobia by having him spend a night with her in the mountain cabin, per a book on claustrophobia found in her rucksack

attrs.stated_reason_present: scouting the campground ahead of a trip with friends next week
photographing azaleas on his phone for his blog

attrs.description: beautiful; the children present said she resembled Ai Haibara
attrs.detail: had secretly been living in the mountain cabin's attic; broke the chained door open with the axe to free the trapped children, told them to hide, then left before Conan's group arrived

attrs.wound_analysis: wound struck from upper right descending to lower left, consistent with a right-handed swing
attrs.later_use: used by the unidentified woman to break down the cabin's chained door

attrs.shoe_size_at_scene: 26 cm (matches all three suspects, so inconclusive alone)

attrs.detail: victim was placed inside still breathing; bloodied handprints on the inside show she moved her hands after being put in

attrs.luminol_result: positive for blood despite an apparent attempt to wash them

clues.desc: Victim's dying finger shape first misread as digits '2','3' (niisan); overlaying both bloodied hands and lighting them from the side instead reveals a rabbit (usagi) shadow puppet -- a pun on the culprit's name, which she habitually made for the kindergarten kids.

Axe wound on the corpse angles from upper-right down to lower-left, and the digger's footprints by the hole show the left foot forward with the right foot trailing -- both independently indicate the killer is right-handed.
Of the three men found on the mountain, Yonezumi and Iwakuma were each seen using only their left hand while Usagi used only his right -- singling out Usagi as the sole right-hander among them.

edges.method: struck her back with the cabin axe during a claustrophobia-induced panic attack
